thailand-national-2025.notes: Source 2 (codeforces.com/gym/106069/standings) is the Gym mirror's own standings: 10 ranked virtual participants ('#', Codeforces handles, e.g. Indian and Chinese teams) plus 113 unofficial rows; not the national contest's results, so roles [] / wrong-contest (no catalogue id for a Gym mirror). The Gym holds only six problems (D, E, F, G, H, L, 'Partial'); its About Contest note says they are two setters' problems from the national contest. The Statements (en) attachment is a ZIP (icpc-2025-kmitl-final.zip) that may be a candidate source. No page prints a contest date.
